page.title: Watchdog
page.description: Watches the internet link and climbs a recovery ladder when it goes down.
page.unreadableTitle: Could not read the watchdog settings

off.label: Off
off.blurb: The watchdog is not watching the connection.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.blurb: The modem is not answering, so we cannot say what the watchdog is doing.

starting.label: Starting
starting.blurb: The service was just enabled and has not reported yet.

not_running.label: Not reporting
not_running.blurb: Enabled, but the watchdog has stopped reporting.

auto_disabled.label: Turned itself off
auto_disabled.blurb: It reached the reboot limit. Turn it back on once the link is stable.

monitor.label: Monitoring
monitor.blurb: The connection is healthy. Watching for outages.

suspect.label: Checking
suspect.blurb: A connectivity check just failed. Confirming before acting.

recovery.label: Recovering
recovery.blurb: Working through the recovery ladder to restore the connection.

cooldown.label: Cooling down
cooldown.blurb: Waiting for the last recovery step to settle before rechecking.

locked.label: Paused
locked.blurb: Maintenance is in progress, so the watchdog is holding off.

radio_off.blurb: The radio is off, so the watchdog is holding off.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.blurb: The service is running but switched off.

ssr_hold.label: Holding
ssr_hold.blurb: The baseband is restarting on its own. Recovery waits for it to come back.

tier1.name: Re-register to the network
tier1.consequence: The link drops for a few seconds.

tier2.name: Restart the radio
tier2.consequence: Skipped while a tower lock is active.

tier3.name: Switch to the backup SIM
tier3.consequence: Rides on the backup until you revert.

failback.name: Switch back to the primary SIM
failback.consequence: Retries the primary; the link drops briefly each try.

detection.title: Detection
detection.description: How quickly a quiet link counts as an outage.

timeline.off: The watchdog is off, so nothing runs.
timeline.none: No steps are armed, so nothing runs.
timeline.invalid: Enter valid detection values to preview the timeline.
timeline.stopped: Step 3 has no slot, so the ladder stops there.

ssr.label: Baseband restart hold
ssr.caption: Lets a modem self-restart finish first

activity.title: Recovery Activity

page.title: Prometheus
page.description: Let a Prometheus server collect this modem's signal and health readings.

card.title: Prometheus Metrics
card.description: Scraping needs the token below; device identifiers are never included.

endpoint.label: Metrics endpoint
endpoint.consequence_on: Prometheus can read signal, carrier and health readings with the token.

freshness.label: Scrape freshness
freshness.hint: Applies only while Prometheus scrapes at least once a minute. Normal polling resumes two minutes after the last scrape.

consequence.adaptive: Scrapes don't change how often the modem is read.
consequence.balanced: The modem never drops to its slowest polling while Prometheus scrapes.
consequence.realtime: The modem is read every 2 seconds while Prometheus scrapes, like an open dashboard.

facts.adaptive_off: Adaptive polling is off, so readings are always live

token.label: Bearer token
token.consequence: Paste it into Prometheus as the scrape credential.

regenerate_dialog.title: Generate a new token?
regenerate_dialog.description: Prometheus can't scrape until you paste the new token into its config.

config.label: Scrape Config
config.consequence: Add this job to your Prometheus configuration.
config.hint: The modem's certificate is self-signed, so verification is skipped. Over Tailscale, plain http works too.
config.empty_description: Turn on the endpoint and save to get one.

foot.token_on_save: A token is created when you save.
